articleTitle: Circuit design implications for silicon photonics
abstract: Silicon photonics offers potentially enormous interchip bandwidth density. We discuss several circuit design issues, often overlooked, central to their implementation: thermal stability/control, DC-tracking, circuit calibration, and loss optimization, and how they affect system considerations.

articleTitle: Facebook's data center network architecture
abstract: We review Facebook's current data center network architecture and explore some alternative architectures.

articleTitle: AWGR-based all-to-all optical interconnects using limited number of wavelengths
abstract: This work discusses all-to-all interconnections for N nodes using W wavelengths and arrayed waveguide grating routers (AWGRs). This scheme allows for reducing the optical wiring by a factor of W(N-l)/2N and isolating the crosstalk. The benefits of optical wiring savings and crosstalk reductions are analyzed in detail. The performance improvement using such interconnection architectures is verified by simulation based benchmarking.

articleTitle: Multicore optical fiber and connectors for high bandwidth density, short reach optical links
abstract: Multicore fiber technology can play a key role in very high bandwidth density optical interconnects that will be needed for short range communications in next-generation data centers and high performance computers.

articleTitle: How to stop interconnects from hindering the future of computing!
abstract: Unprecedented transistor integration capacity will be available to make computing truly ubiquitous, but the energy consumption will be a major challenge. Compute energy can be reduced by employing near threshold voltage operation. However, data movement energy will become prohibitive. Severe tapering of interconnect bandwidth brings power consumption within limit, but potentially hindering the system performance.

articleTitle: High density, low cost, no-polish optical ferrule
abstract: A monolithic, multi-fiber ferule with integrated collimating lenses with the same overall footprint as a traditional MT-type ferrule was tested for insertion loss and return loss, before and after durability testing without cleaning.

articleTitle: Ultra-low latency optical switching for short message sizes in cluster scale systems
abstract: A key performance criteria for many applications is the low latency delivery of small messages. We develop the SPINet (Scalable Photonic Interconnection Network) architecture for rack scale systems that can deliver near time-of-flight latencies.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of micro-ring based switch elements in silicon photonics for optical interconnection
abstract: A two-ring add/drop switch is presented for scalable switching matrix architectures. The device performance is investigated using the transfer matrix method, showing low crosstalks, high out of band rejection and side-lobe suppression.

articleTitle: Integrated control of silicon-photonic micro-resonator wavelength via balanced homodyne locking
abstract: We present a new method for active control of optical micro-resonator modulator and filter wavelength that is insensitive to environmental and optical perturbations and readily integrated on-chip. Experimental results demonstrating precise, long-term filter locking are shown.

articleTitle: Approaches for a viable Germanium laser: Tensile strain, GeSn alloys, and n-type doping
abstract: We model the impact of tensile strain, GeSn alloys and n-type doping on the performance of germanium-based lasers. Ultimately, doping offers limited benefits, whereas GeSn and strain can reduce the lasing threshold by >100x.

articleTitle: Integrated microring tuning in deep-trench bulk CMOS
abstract: An all-digital ΔΣ-based heater driver and a 6-μm diameter microring resonator are monolithically-integrated in deep-trench bulk CMOS. With clock scaling and 2.5V supply voltage, the system demonstrates a 350GHz tuning range and 10-15μW/GHz tuning efficiencies.

articleTitle: Microring resonance stabilization using thermal dithering
abstract: We present the novel mechanism of thermal dithering for breaking the symmetry of a microring resonance, and experimentally show it can be utilized to thermally stabilize a silicon microring resonator experiencing fluctuations of 3 K.

articleTitle: Nanoscale resonant-cavity-enhanced Germanium photodetectors with lithographically defined spectral response for improved performance at telecommunications wavelengths
abstract: We demonstrate planar resonant photodetectors based on germanium fins self-aligned to metallic slits. By varying the fin widths, we engineer detectors with tunable and extended spectral response spanning the telecommunications Cand L-bands.

articleTitle: 960 Gb/s optical backplane using embedded polymer waveguides and demonstration in a 12G SAS storage array
abstract: An emerging eco-system is described enabling Tb/s bandwidth optical backplanes based on embedded polymer waveguides, passive optical backplane connectors and mid-board optical transceivers capable of bandwidths up to 28 Gb/s per lane.

articleTitle: Hybrid integrated DWDM silicon photonic transceiver with self-adaptive CMOS circuits
abstract: We present a DWDM silicon photonic transceiver with self-adaptive CMOS circuits. The energy efficiency is 808fJ/bit at 5Gbps for a ring-modulator based transmitter and 275fJ/bit at 8Gbps with BER<;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup> for the receiver.

articleTitle: Integration of silicon photonics in a bulk CMOS memory flow
abstract: Monolithically integrated silicon photonic (SiP) devices have been demonstrated using a modified bulk CMOS flow. Integration was achieved by nominally extending existing process and design collateral without shifting the CMOS parameterization.

articleTitle: Low loss optical interlayer coupling using reflector-enhanced grating couplers
abstract: We demonstrate improved optical interlayer coupling based on grating couplers with backside metal reflectors. Losses of 1.5dB and 2.0dB are achieved with 145nm and 220nm grating etch depth on a 130nm SOI CMOS platform, respectively.

articleTitle: Evaluation of optical interconnects built up from a complete CMOS-photonics-devices-library
abstract: We evaluate the performances of optical interconnects that could be built up from our current CMOS-Photonics-devices library (monolithically integrated III-V-on-Si-lasers, ring-modulators, photo-detectors, and tunable ring-filters). Two operating temperatures are considered.

articleTitle: “Optical electronic data transfer technical gaps, needs and non-needs extracted from industry Roadmaps (iNemi, ITRS and the MIT CTR)”
abstract: Optical data transmission applications emerging from the Roadmaps; raising Telecom bandwidth efficiency, the role for PICs; microprocessor IO Bandwidth density and optical interposers; data center power reduction; optical backplanes; on-chip interconnect.

articleTitle: Energy-per-bit advantages of chip-scale hybrid-integrated optical interconnects using surface-normal electro-aborption MQW modulators
abstract: A hybrid MQW/EAM-based chip-scale photonic interconnect concept is projected to achieve significantly lower energy-per-bit performance than monolithically integrated Si-Photonic and directly-modulated VCSEL approaches - enabling bandwidth density to scale with foreseeable high performance computing CMOS technology.

articleTitle: FPGA controlled microring based tunable add-drop filter
abstract: We demonstrate a microring based add-drop filter controlled by a field programmable gate array (FPGA). Specialized heater design maintains tuning performance of the device under non-optimized applied voltages, thus avoiding complicated control circuitry.

articleTitle: Integrated bidirectional optical amplifier for crosstalk-free WDM communication
abstract: By exploiting non-reciprocal magneto-optic micro-ring resonators, hybrid III-V semiconductor optical amplifiers can be effectively integrated to provide crosstalk-free bidirectional interleaved WDM communication between racks.

articleTitle: Polymer waveguide based optical backplanes and electro-optical assembly technology for computing applications
abstract: We report on recent developments of our board-level optical interconnect technology towards polymer waveguide flexes and on the adaption of connectorization and electro-optical assembly methods to be used in optical backplanes and high-density optical subassemblies.

articleTitle: Energy efficient 850 nm vcsels for error-free 30 gb/s operation across 500 m of multimode optical fiber with 85 fj of dissipated energy per bit
abstract: Error-free operation at 25 and 30 Gb/s across 1 km and 500 m of multimode fiber is achieved with 100 and 85 fJ of dissipated energy per bit using narrow spectral-width 850 nm vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers.

articleTitle: 5.5-fJ/bit direct modulation of lambda-scale embedded active region photonic-crystal lasers
abstract: We demonstrate direct modulations of photonic-crystal nanocavity lasers. Only a 35-μA bias current is required for 10-Gb/s modulation with a bit-error rate better than the forward error correction limit, resulting in a 5.5-fJ/bit energy cost.

articleTitle: The role of optical links in HPC system interconnects
abstract: As high-performance scientific computing continues to advance to higher degrees of parallel computing power, the system interconnect becomes a more critical performance-related resource. Optical links have been used strategically to reduce cost per performance in HPC system interconnects for the past decade. In this paper, we explore the performance implications of optical link performance on scientific applications in leading network designs, placing optical signaling technology in the context of its usefulness to HPC system interconnects.

articleTitle: Loss analysis for a two wire optical waveguide for chip-to-chip communication
abstract: An optical interconnect system for chip-to-chip communication using gold bond wires as a two wire waveguide is proposed. Such an optical waveguide scheme would greatly simplify inter-chip optical communication compared with existing waveguide concepts.

articleTitle: Timing jitter of optical clock distribution induced by photodetection
abstract: Lower limit of the timing jitter in an optical clock distribution network due to shot and thermal noise using a realistic photo detector model is derived and its dependence on received energy is analyzed.

articleTitle: L-shaped resonant microring (LRM) modulator
abstract: A high-speed silicon L-shaped resonant microring modulator, enables directly integrated electrical contacts, 5-μm diameter, 5.3-THz free spectral range, is demonstrated error-free operation up to 30-Gb/s with 1.76-dB insertion loss and 2.8-dB power penalty.

articleTitle: 30GHz silicon platform for photonics system
abstract: We present a silicon photonic platform offering low loss passive components, integrated highspeed silicon traveling wave MZ modulators (30GHz), ring modulators (45GHz) and inductance peaking Germanium photodetectors (58GHz). The bandwidth of the photonic devices is sufficient to support 50Gb/s bit rate. Our platform is available to the community as part of the OpSIS project.

articleTitle: Athermal silicon ring modulators clad with titanium dioxide by RF magnetron sputtering
abstract: We present design, fabrication and measurement of athermal silicon ring modulators fabricated on a SOI platform, overclad with 830nm thick amorphous titanium dioxide. Current injection achieves 35 dB extinction intensity modulation.

articleTitle: Efficient surface normal multi-stage grating couplers in silicon based waveguides
abstract: A multi-stage fiber-grating coupler design is evolved from random conditions, fabricated, and tested on a silicon platform. Simultaneous input/output coupling from a standard fiber array at perfectly normal incidence yields a 59.8% efficiency per grating.

articleTitle: Steerable free space optical interconnect with corrugated waveguide gratings optically isolated by 2D photonic crystal
abstract: An optical phased array of corrugated waveguide gratings is fabricated to realize free space optical interconnects with wavelength routing. A 2D photonic crystal is experimentally shown to prevent optical crosstalk between closely spaced array elements.

articleTitle: Integrated photodiode characterization in a SiGe BiCMOS process
abstract: In this paper three photodetector structures were simulated, fabricated and characterized at 850nm in a SiGe BiCMOS process. The measurement and simulation results suggest that the additional vertical layers offered by SiGe process compared to CMOS can facilitate higher detector bandwidth at the expense of reduced low frequency responsivity.

articleTitle: Scalable electrical-optical thermal simulator for multicores with optical interconnects
abstract: We present a framework for fast and scalable thermal transient simulation embedded into manycore architectural simulator. With speed-up of 13-300x over prior approaches, our solver enables fine-grain thermal simulation without slowing down the architectural simulation.

articleTitle: RODIN — Energy-proportional soa-based optical interconnect for large computing platforms
abstract: The idle mode of switching gates leads to energy-proportional interconnection networks while operating conditions and performance have an impact on their scalability. SOA-based gates are modeled and their operating conditions are optimized for scalability.

articleTitle: A compact 10×10 Gbps transmitter module based on a low cost 3D stacking solution
abstract: We demonstrate a wafer-scale process for making compact 3D stacked 10×10 Gbps transmitter chips. Error-free operation is obtained for 0 and 500 meter transmission in OM4-Plus fiber with a maximum 1.4 dB Rx sensitivity penalty.

articleTitle: A small form factor Si-based coherent receiver
abstract: A coherent receiver based on silicon photonics is presented. Its performance is confirmed at 112 Gb/s with PM-QPSK modulation at 28 Gbaud up to 4800 km and at 224 Gb/s with PM-16QAM up to 640 km. The packaged core has very compact dimensions of 6mm×8mm.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of high-speed reconfigurable card-to-card optical interconnects with broadcast capability
abstract: A free-space-based high-speed reconfigurable card-to-card optical interconnect architecture with broadcasting capability is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. Results show that 10 Gb/s data can be broadcast to all channels with a worst-case receiver sensitivity better than -12.20 dBm.

articleTitle: Generating QAM signals with microring modulators
abstract: A compact scheme for generation of M-ary quadrature amplitude modulation signals is presented using two mutually decoupled microring resonators connected in series. The capabilities of the scheme are demonstrated via generation of 16 QAM by means of simulation.

articleTitle: Intelligent THz photonic processor for interconnection networks based on spike timing dependent plasticity
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a bio-inspired intelligent hybrid photonic processing devices for optical interconnection networks which is capable of performing complex processing of broadband signal as well as learning and adapting to changes.

articleTitle: Design optimization of energy-efficient hydrophobic wafer-bonded III-V/Si semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: We discuss optimum design strategies for high-efficiency hybrid semiconductor optical amplifiers. Optimizing the bonding layer, III-V wafer stack design, straight hybrid amplifier dimensions, and flared amplifier configurations leads to a design for up to 35% wall-plug efficiency at 2mW input and 10dB gain.

articleTitle: Development of a chip-to-chip optical interconnect system
abstract: We present the design and simulation of a high efficient optical chip-to-chip coupling structure. The position tolerance (3dB coupling efficiency) can be as large as 1.0 μm when the polymer waveguide diameter equals 6.0 μm.

articleTitle: Apodized focusing subwavelength gratings for simultaneous coupling of TE and TM modes
abstract: Apodized focusing subwavelength gratings which can couple both transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM) modes are presented. The coupling efficiencies were -3.0 dB and -4.0 dB for TM and TE modes, respectively.

articleTitle: Layer separation optimization in CMOS compatible multilayer optical networks
abstract: We explore the design space surrounding a CMOS compatible silicon nitride over silicon-on-insulator 3D optical layer for photonic interconnection networks and compare the results with single layer approaches.

articleTitle: A fully-integrated flexible photonic platform for chip-to-chip optical interconnects
abstract: We analyze a chip-to-chip optical interconnect platform based on our recently developed flexible substrate integration technology. We show that the architecture achieves high integration density, low energy-per-bit, and does not require optical alignment during packaging.

articleTitle: Millimeter-bending-radius fiber bus for optical interconnects
abstract: A space-division-multiplexed microstructured optical-fiber bus is modeled and optimized to meet the stringent requirements of chip-to-chip optical interconnects. It features a channel density > 28 ch/mm, millimetre bending radius and crosstalk low enough for >10 Gb/s transmission rate.

articleTitle: Polarization independent and low loss laser written polysiloxane interconnect building blocks
abstract: Single-mode polysiloxane based waveguides and directional couplers, key optical interconnect building blocks, were fabricated using direct laser writing. Key performance parameters include polarization independent propagation loss of 0.23 dB/cm and a possible wafer scale fabrication.

articleTitle: Characterization of coplanar poled electro optic polymer films for Si-photonic devices with multiphoton microscopy
abstract: The authors demonstrated the feasibility of second-harmonic microscopic imaging for the the characterization of poled polymer film for application in silicon electro-optic polymer hybrid devices. The results are so far qualitative and can be used to optimize the poling conditions as long as the sample geometry is preserved.

articleTitle: InAlAs/InGaAs quantum cascade laser with concentric racetrack array cavity
abstract: In this paper we propose a Quantum Cascade Laser with concentric racetracks as Fabry-Perot cavities. The electronic part at 300K and 350K is numerically analyzed using Finite Element Vectorial method and FDTD for optical cavity behavior.

articleTitle: Evaluation of SiGe multiple quantum well modulators for short-reach, dense wavelength division multiplexed optical interconnects
abstract: By modeling temperature-dependent SiGe MQW electroabsorption, we calculate the number of allowed DWDM channels as a function of operating temperature, applied voltage, and a figure of merit related to the laser power penalty. We find that 20 to 40 DWDM channels at 100 GHz and 50 GHz channel spacing is possible in DWDM links with a ~12° temperature range with less than a 1 dB laser power penalty compared to the optimum single channel, single temperature case. The same number of channels can be supported over a 37° temperature range with a 3 dB power penalty.

articleTitle: Electro-optic threshold comparator based on multimode interference
abstract: A device with step-like O/E response is described. The proposed comparator consists of silicon-based Multimode Interference couplers and phase shifters delivering a set of sine-wave responses of different amplitudes and phases which are superimposed according to the Fourier series representation of a square-wave.

articleTitle: Packaging technology for embedded optical modules
abstract: We present packaging technology for creating compact, high-data rate fiber optic components that are compatible with high-temperature operation and solder reflow board assembly. We describe the application of this technology for mid-board optical communications.

articleTitle: Modeling a multi microring (MMR) network-on-chip
abstract: This paper proposes an optical network-on-chip consisting of a central microring resonating with the local microrings connected to the ports. The mathematical model of the multi microring (MMR) architecture shows good crosstalk robustness.

articleTitle: A photonic interconnection network for hardware accelerator enabled utility computing
abstract: High-bandwidth connectivity provided by WDM optical interconnects is an important enabler for delocalized hardware accelerators in utility computing. We validate a proposed architecture with an experiment that leverages optical interconnects to demonstrate error free (BER<;10e-12) active switching and multicasting of FPGA generated and received packets.

articleTitle: Breaking the energy-bandwidth limit of electro-optic modulators: Theory and a device proposal
abstract: We analytically derive the energy-bandwidth limit for electro-optic modulators based on intra-cavity index modulation, and propose a dual cavity modulator using coupling modulation to simultaneously achieve high bandwidth (80 GHz) and ultra-low energy-per-bit (0.26 aJ).

articleTitle: Inter-layer grating coupler on double-layer silicon nanomembranes
abstract: We present an adhesive bonding process to fabricate on-chip, double-layer, single crystalline silicon nanomembranes. Inter-layer coupling efficiency of 25% with 35 nm 3dB bandwidth is demonstrated using subwavelength nanostructure based grating couplers.

articleTitle: The impact of networking trends and architectures on optical technology requirements
abstract: Global Internet traffic continues to grow at an unprecedented pace driven by consumer adoption of devices and services. This paper will explore the network trends and technology challenges necessary to address this demand.

articleTitle: Integration of passive components with high performance quantum dot lasers on silicon
abstract: In this paper, the authors devised a novel laser design that use InAs QD lasers monolithically integrated with silicon waveguides and other Si photonic passive components. Due to their unique structures, the QD lasers have been proven by several groups to have the combination of high temperature stability, large modulation bandwidth and low power consumption compared with their QW counterparts, which makes it an ideal candidate for Si photonic applications.

articleTitle: Differential signaling for low optical energy consumption in datacom optical interconnects
abstract: We propose the use of differential signaling based on parallel transmission of complementary M-ary PAM optical waveforms over fibers of approximately the same length, in conjunction with balanced direct detection, to reduce optical interconnect energy consumption.

articleTitle: Optical multi-Gbps board-to-board interconnection with integrated FPGA-based diagnostics
abstract: The demonstration of an optical multi-Gbps board-to-board interconnection is presented consisting of 12 parallel FPGA-based high speed links with 8.5 Gbps. The optical interconnection is realized by novel 3D fiber-matrix connectors including multi mode ribbon-fiber bundles. The performance of the interconnection is evaluated with regard to optical properties, scalability and power consumption.

articleTitle: Intra- and inter- board optical interconnects by polymeric waveguides and mirror coupler with inkjet-printed micro-lenses
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate intra- and inter- board optical interconnects utilizing molded waveguides and mirror couplers with inkjet-printed microlenses. 10 Gbps Data transmission reveals inter-board interconnects with BER 1.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> and 6.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-13</sup> without and with micro-lenses, respectively.

articleTitle: A silicon-polymer hybrid modulator — Simulation and proof of principle
abstract: Optimal dimensions are found for the silicon waveguide in an electro-optic (EO) polymer cladding-based silicon waveguide modulator. The confinement factor as well as the effective index of the mode are taken into account. With the optimal 275 nm waveguide width and 4 μm electrode spacing, V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub> of a few volts can be achieved even with low r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</sub> EO polymers.

articleTitle: Optical interconnections based on elastic spatial-spectral interworking
abstract: Optical interconnections can be employed in multidimensional schemes that incorporate ultra-dense arrangements of optical subcarriers in the spectral domain and a multitude of independent modes in the spatial domain, all within the same optical fiber. In this paper we further explore the concept of dynamic optical spatial-spectral interconnections enabling elastic bandwidth arrangement.

articleTitle: Low-power vcsel-based optical interconnects
abstract: The energy-per-bit consumption of VCSEL-based optical interconnects has fallen steadily over the years. The basis for continuing this trend will be discussed by examining improvements in component technologies: VCSELs, photodiodes, and integrated circuits.
